missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Крыльцо' is a neuter noun in the nominative as the subject. 'Деревянное' and 'старое' are the agreeing neuter adjectives. A clean descriptive card.

missions.phrase: Мы покрасили крыльцо в белый цвет.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Крыльцо' is neuter, so its accusative equals the nominative as the object of 'покрасили'. 'В белый цвет' names the colour. Practical home-improvement language.
Strategic focus: Genitive of location. 'Крыльца' is the genitive after 'у', marking the place near which the step broke. 'Нашего' is the agreeing neuter genitive. Common spatial usage.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Крыльце' is the prepositional form after 'на', telling where the cat sleeps. A very common everyday location pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Крыльцу' is the dative after 'к', expressing motion toward the porch. The verb 'подошёл' reinforces the approach. A core direction pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental with a spatial preposition. 'Крыльцом' is the instrumental after 'перед', meaning in front of the porch. 'Растут цветы' completes the scene. Useful for describing yards.

missions.phrase: Дети сидят на крыльце и едят мороженое.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional location with activity. 'Крыльце' is prepositional after 'на', anchoring where the children sit. The second clause adds a natural everyday activity. Reinforces the same ending.

missions.phrase: В деревне у каждого дома есть крыльцо.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative with existence. 'Крыльцо' is nominative as the thing that exists in 'есть'. 'В деревне' and 'у каждого дома' set the scene. A natural generalisation.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Крыльца' is the neuter nominative plural as the subject. 'Красивые' is the agreeing plural adjective, and 'у старых домов' shows whose porches. Good plural practice.
Strategic focus: Nominative as logical subject. 'Крыльцо' is nominative, the thing that needs fixing in the impersonal 'нужно' construction. 'Это' points at it. A useful modal pattern.
